--- select_hash_join_methods.sql
SELECT * FROM A
INNER HASH JOIN B ON A.id = B.id
LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN C USING (id)
RIGHT OUTER HASH JOIN D ON C.id = D.id
FULL OUTER HASH JOIN E USING (id)
CROSS HASH JOIN F

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.Star{
        Star: 7,
      },
    },
    From: &ast.From{
      From:   9,
      Source: &ast.Join{
        Left: &ast.Join{
          Left: &ast.Join{
            Left: &ast.Join{
              Left: &ast.Join{
                Left: &ast.TableName{
                  Table: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 14,
                    NameEnd: 15,
                    Name:    "A",
                  },
                },
                Op:     "INNER",
                Method: "HASH",
                Right:  &ast.TableName{
                  Table: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 32,
                    NameEnd: 33,
                    Name:    "B",
                  },
                },
                Cond: &ast.On{
                  On:   34,
                  Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
                    Op:   "=",
                    Left: &ast.Path{
                      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                        &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 37,
                          NameEnd: 38,
                          Name:    "A",
                        },
                        &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 39,
                          NameEnd: 41,
                          Name:    "id",
                        },
                      },
                    },
                    Right: &ast.Path{
                      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                        &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 44,
                          NameEnd: 45,
                          Name:    "B",
                        },
                        &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 46,
                          NameEnd: 48,
                          Name:    "id",
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
              Op:     "LEFT OUTER",
              Method: "HASH",
              Right:  &ast.TableName{
                Table: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 70,
                  NameEnd: 71,
                  Name:    "C",
                },
              },
              Cond: &ast.Using{
                Using:  72,
                Rparen: 81,
                Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 79,
                    NameEnd: 81,
                    Name:    "id",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
            Op:     "RIGHT OUTER",
            Method: "HASH",
            Right:  &ast.TableName{
              Table: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 105,
                NameEnd: 106,
                Name:    "D",
              },
            },
            Cond: &ast.On{
              On:   107,
              Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
                Op:   "=",
                Left: &ast.Path{
                  Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 110,
                      NameEnd: 111,
                      Name:    "C",
                    },
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 112,
                      NameEnd: 114,
                      Name:    "id",
                    },
                  },
                },
                Right: &ast.Path{
                  Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 117,
                      NameEnd: 118,
                      Name:    "D",
                    },
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 119,
                      NameEnd: 121,
                      Name:    "id",
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          Op:     "FULL OUTER",
          Method: "HASH",
          Right:  &ast.TableName{
            Table: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 143,
              NameEnd: 144,
              Name:    "E",
            },
          },
          Cond: &ast.Using{
            Using:  145,
            Rparen: 154,
            Idents: []*ast.Ident{
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 152,
                NameEnd: 154,
                Name:    "id",
              },
            },
          },
        },
        Op:     "CROSS",
        Method: "HASH",
        Right:  &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 172,
            NameEnd: 173,
            Name:    "F",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT * FROM A INNER HASH JOIN B ON A.id = B.id LEFT OUTER HASH JOIN C USING (id) RIGHT OUTER HASH JOIN D ON C.id = D.id FULL OUTER HASH JOIN E USING (id) CROSS HASH JOIN F
